title: add-contrib-playbook-index-and-rag-contrib-templates
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Added a new `docs/contrib` section with contribution-ready RAG playbook templates, a community playbook index, and a lightweight test harness for template validation. No runtime or API changes.
description:
Context & motivation: external contributors frequently open PRs adding RAG playbooks and agent examples, but onboarding and review are slow because (1) there is no standardized template for playbooks, (2) examples often omit structured-output contracts and test harnesses, and (3) docs lack a discoverable index for community-contributed templates. This PR introduces a contrib playbook index and a set of contributor-facing templates and validation helpers to reduce review friction and improve quality for community-submitted RAG artifacts.

What this change does: adds a new `docs/contrib/` section and example assets under `examples/rag/contrib-templates/`. Key contents: * docs/contrib/README.md — overview and contribution guide tailored to RAG templates (how to write a playbook, required metadata, linting rules). * docs/contrib/playbook-index.md — searchable index of contributed playbooks with metadata schema and tagging guidance. * examples/rag/contrib-templates/stepwise-playbook-template.yaml — a canonical stepwise RAG playbook (tool binding examples, timebox annotations, telemetry probes). * examples/rag/contrib-templates/contracted-agent-example.ts — small TS agent stub with structured-output schema and inline tests. * tools/rag-template-validator/ — lightweight node-based harness that validates front-matter, structured-output contracts, and runs local smoke interactions against the Redwood test shim. * docs/snippets/structured-output-linter.md — docs describing how to opt-in to structured output linting and add CI checks.

Commits (high-level): * 3d4b9e4 — initial scaffold: add docs/contrib README and index page + placeholder metadata schema * 8c2a1b7 — add stepwise-playbook-template.yaml and agent stub example * b5f7c12 — integrate rag-template-validator with README usage and add small test fixtures * d1aef45 — apply feedback: clearer metadata fields, examples for telemetry probes, tidy copy + unit tests for validator harness

Files changed (high level): * docs/contrib/README.md (new) * docs/contrib/playbook-index.md (new) * docs/snippets/structured-output-linter.md (new) * examples/rag/contrib-templates/stepwise-playbook-template.yaml (new) * examples/rag/contrib-templates/contracted-agent-example.ts (new) * tools/rag-template-validator/package.json, index.ts, tests/* (new) * website/sidebar.json (updated to expose contrib section) * .github/workflows/rag-template-ci.yml (new lightweight CI job that runs validator on PRs under examples/rag/contrib-templates)

Small illustrative excerpt (playbook front-matter): "---
title: 'Customer-support RAG playbook (stepwise)'
tags: ['support','faq','agent']
author: '{{contributor_name}}'
outputs:
  - name: resolution_summary
    type: structured
    schema: '{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"summary\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"ticket_id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}'
---\"

Review conversation summary: * Ethan Morgan (reviewer): "Love the validator harness. Please add a short migration note in the playbook-index for existing examples we already host." — addressed in d1aef45 with an added paragraph in playbook-index.md. * Lena Cho: "Can you provide a TypeScript example showing function/tool-calling with explicit output contracts?" — added contracted-agent-example.ts and inline comments, responded in the PR thread. * Marco Ruiz: requested a smaller CI job matrix to keep exec time low; updated .github workflow to run the validator first and only run smoke interactions on label 'run-smoke'. * Reviewer approvals: Ethan approved after changes, Lena approved with minor comments left as TODOs.

CI summary: * Lint: pass * Docsite build: pass * rag-template-validator tests: initially one flaky fixture failing (smoke-interaction), re-ran and fixed race condition in tests — final status: pass * GitHub Actions: new workflow rag-template-ci triggered on examples/rag/contrib-templates changes; validated on this branch.

Security & compliance: No secrets or infra changes. The validator runs only local mock interactions against the Redwood test shim; it does not call any external hosted model endpoints by default. Contributors can opt into live-run smoke tests via explicit label, which is documented.

Backward compatibility & migration: Non-breaking. Existing docs and examples remain untouched; website sidebar is updated to surface the contrib index. We include a short migration note for maintainers to tag older community playbooks with metadata fields required by the validator.

How to test locally: 1) bootstrap node dependencies under tools/rag-template-validator 2) run `npm run test` to validate fixtures 3) run `node index.js validate examples/rag/contrib-templates/stepwise-playbook-template.yaml` for a quick lint + contract check 4) optionally add label `run-smoke` to trigger the mock-interaction smoke runner in CI (documented in docs/contrib/README.md).

Follow-ups & future work: * Add quickstart that converts an existing example into the new front-matter format (LOW priority). * Integrate the validator as an opt-in GitHub App so maintainers can enforce the schema automatically.

Merge outcome: merged via squash by Evelyn Brooks on 2026-02-18 after final approvals. Thank you to everyone who reviewed and contributed test fixtures and copy edits.
